references.text: The instruction to make the robe of the ephod from blue cloth, as Exodus 39:22 describes its execution.
The robe (מְעִיל) is mentioned as part of the holy garments that were to be made for Aaron.
The introduction to the work on the holy garments, including the use of blue (תְּכֵלֶת) cloth.
Moses clothed Aaron with the robe (מְעִיל) during the consecration of the priests.
Description of how they made tunics of fine linen by weaving (מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג), the same technique used for the robe.
The source shows the fulfillment of the explicit instruction given in this verse.
